memory_lessons.applicability: Timing anchor only; this establishes no outcome for the cached-state candidate.
memory_lessons.claim: The supplied baseline-e1 is valid and correct with a mean of 0.3109329016666666 seconds over three samples; the role catalog had no prior T1 records or distinct candidate programs.
memory_lessons.next_experiment: Measure xy_lattice_fraction_only including vector allocation and state access; validate n=768 plus smaller and shifted bounds, then compare separate weight/z-state variants.

proposal.hypothesis: Caching only the masked lattice index and fraction for each x/y axis coordinate at each octave removes repeated per-pixel coordinate scaling and floor operations. The compact O(8(width+height)) state may be offset by allocation and repeated state loads; no speedup is assumed. Smooth weights and z state remain uncached in this first-stage variant.

retained: Precompute masked lattice indices and fractions for x and y once per axis coordinate and octave, preserving x0+i*dx then lambda multiplication order.
Retain the original eight-octave lambda/o progression and per-pixel accumulation order; continue computing smooth weights and z noise state in the noise evaluation.
Allocate the per-axis state vectors within noise_serial so their allocation and state-access cost is included in candidate timing.
